playbooks.summary: Prioritize understanding the operational impact of a critical supplier's potential bankruptcy and securing continuity of supply.
steps: Initiate immediate inventory assessment for affected components and finished goods from the identified supplier.
Identify all products and internal processes reliant on the potentially bankrupt supplier.
Begin preliminary identification of alternative suppliers and sourcing strategies.
Estimate the potential impact on production schedules and customer commitments.
Formulate contingency plans to mitigate supply disruption.

playbooks.summary: Focus on securing immediate and long-term alternative supply sources and managing contractual implications with the affected supplier.
steps: Contact the identified supplier to ascertain the status of their operations and future capabilities.
Expedite engagement with pre-qualified alternative suppliers for affected materials.
Initiate negotiations for alternative supply agreements to ensure continuity.
Review current purchase orders and contracts with the affected supplier for potential termination clauses or remedies.
Collaborate with Legal to understand implications of supplier non-performance.

playbooks.summary: Provide a comprehensive impact assessment of the supplier bankruptcy and monitor market conditions.
steps: Conduct a deep dive into the financial health and operational stability of the identified supplier.
Assess the broader market impact of a major pharmaceutical supplier experiencing distress in its region.
Identify any interconnected risks with other suppliers or parts of the supply chain.
Provide regular updates on the evolving situation and potential cascading effects.
Recommend specific data points for ongoing monitoring to the crisis team.

recoveryOptions.title: Expedite inbound on the most exposed lanes
recoveryOptions.summary: Move the most exposed inbound to priority/air freight to close the gap between runout and supplier recovery.

recoveryOptions.title: Activate qualified backups for the dual-sourced lanes
recoveryOptions.summary: Switch the lanes that have a qualified backup on file to the alternate supplier while the primary lane is disrupted.

supplierMessages.subject: Request for Operational Status and Impact Assessment
supplierMessages.body: We are initiating an impact assessment and kindly request your input. Please provide details on your current shipment schedule and any potential adjustments. We also ask for an update on your on-hand inventory position and an estimated timeline for recovery. Additionally, please inform us if you are considering or declaring force majeure and share any insights regarding sub-tier supplier exposure. Your prompt response is appreciated as we evaluate next steps.
